Learn More The INTEPO Infrastructure Platform A governance platform embodied in hardware I INTEPO is a decentralized infrastructure platform with governance embedded directly in its hardware. Compact execution nodes combine intelligent power, networking, wired and wireless communications, and local inference to support critical infrastructure in demanding field environments. Nexus is INTEPO’s converged reference implementation, bringing power, communications, computing and storage into a governed field platform. Building on deployed engineering experience, the expanded architecture supports new installations and modernization of suitable existing infrastructure. INTEPO Governed Infrastructure Architecture The INTEPO platform brings together embedded Governance Authorities, modular execution nodes, platform extensions and a converged reference implementation across critical infrastructure environments. The Physical Far Edge Has Not Kept Pace AI Has Advanced. Its Physical Infrastructure Must Catch Up. AI is moving to cell towers, streets, utilities and remote locations. Yet deploying it still too often means assembling separate power systems, networking, communications and computing equipment in the field. Each connection adds complexity. Unstable power, extreme conditions and disrupted connectivity make reliable operation harder. Modern intelligence requires a robust, secure, integrated physical foundation—with governance embedded by design. INTEPO Establishes a Governed Infrastructure Foundation INTEPO brings power, networking, communications, computing and storage together in a compact, ruggedized platform—with governance embedded directly into the hardware. Factory integration reduces field assembly and simplifies deployment through a plug-and-play approach. Local governance authorities preserve mission priorities while adapting operations to available power, connectivity and physical conditions. The architecture supports modern nodes for new installations and governance adapters for suitable existing infrastructure. Engineered for Unpredictable Conditions at the Edge. subpages.text: Skip to main content Intepo Menu Platform Infrastructure Deployment About Licence/Partners Investors News Contact us Mission INTEPO develops governed infrastructure for the physical far edge—where power, communications, sensing and computing must remain dependable under changing operating conditions. Modern operations increasingly depend upon distributed infrastructure supporting energy systems, communications networks, transportation, public safety, industrial operations and defense capabilities. The continuity of these systems increasingly determines the continuity of the missions and services they support. Infrastructure should not merely support operations. It should preserve operational continuity. INTEPO addresses this challenge by embedding governance directly within the infrastructure layer. Through deterministic power authority, authenticated communications and governed mission orchestration, distributed systems can respond locally to available resources, environmental conditions and defined mission priorities. Our Experience INTEPO builds upon more than a decade of engineering and field experience developed through BTU Research in resilient power, communications and distributed infrastructure systems. That foundation includes infrastructure deployed in demanding operational environments—from maintaining communications during hurricane-related power loss, to supporting secure federal-building communications and perimeter-security operations at one of Europe’s largest steel-production facilities. These deployments demonstrated that infrastructure cannot depend solely upon centralized control, continuous connectivity or stable utility power.
